name: Toaru Kakutou Shoujo no 4-Nenkan ni Wataru Zecchou Choukyou
original_name: とある格闘少女の4年間に渡る絶頂調教
source:
Special Cultivation City--
A place where students with special abilities are
collected and taught to maximize their skills.

Mikoto Mis*ka was training to be the world champion of kickboxing.

One day, the gears of fate turned drastically.
She came across a bullying situation and intervened,
delivering a critical blow to the bully
... who turned out to be the son of a
wealthy and influential SC City politician.

Mikoto was convicted of assault.
Her punishment was unique. Instead of being exiled
from SC City she was transferred to a low academy
of all boys, who from the very first day
began to have their way with the "criminal".

Her virginity was taken, and her dignity, and her hope.

Four years of crushing misery had begun.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE118521.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
特培育城——
有特殊能力的学生聚集的地方
收集并教授以最大限度地提高他们的技能。

密*香美琴 (Mikoto Mis*ka) 正在接受跆拳道世界冠军的训练。

有一天，命运的齿轮发生了巨大的转动。
她遇到欺凌情况并介入，
给恶霸以致命一击
……原来是一个人的儿子
富有且有影响力的SC市政治家。

美琴被判犯有袭击罪。
她的惩罚是独一无二的。而不是被流放
她从SC市转学到一所低等学院
在所有男孩中，从第一天起
开始对“罪犯”为所欲为。

她的童贞被夺走了，她的尊严被夺走了，她的希望也被夺走了。

四年的极度痛苦开始了。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE118521.html]DLsite English[/url]]
